purpose: Freeze powered fresh-data confirmation requirements before natural-agent or Circle Packing outcomes exist.

circle_confirmation.selection_rule: Choose the lowest discovery budget whose multi-global and multi-partition point effects both meet +0.01 and whose migration compliance passes; otherwise maximize the smaller effect surplus and break ties toward the lower budget.

error_control: Each confirmation is an intersection-union test on fresh data. Both topology contrasts must pass; discovery observations are excluded from confirmation estimates.
implementation_gate: Before launch, bind the fresh natural landscape bundle, selector where applicable, runner, auditor, analyzer, result root, seed hashes, and dry-run evidence in a superseding source registration while all corresponding result roots remain absent.
claim_boundary: Eight-block discovery failures are not absence evidence outside their powered dispersion range. External confirmations remain task- and agent-population-specific and cannot rescue one another.
